intro.text: An ancient Silver Kingdom of eastern Roshar, a militaristic land where the Knights Radiant made their homes.
One of the Silver Kingdoms of Roshar, generally seen as the forerunner of Alethkar, with a perfectly symmetrical name.

description.text: Alethela covered parts of today's Herdaz, Jah Keved, Alethkar and the Unclaimed Hills. Heavy highstorms meant towns were built in the lee of laits.
Alethelan men wore long skirts tied with wide girdles, with simple overshirts or bare chests, and short pointed beards. Buildings were brightly coloured, built of sandstone with large pillars.

Alethela was the most militaristic of the Silver Kingdoms, keeping the arts of war alive to teach them whenever a Desolation came. Many Radiants lived there, though their orders were based in Urithiru.

items.text: Alethela was founded in the Silver Kingdoms epoch. Each Desolation knocked it back, sometimes to stone tools, and the Heralds helped it rebuild.
Early on, Kholinar became its capital.
Before the Sixth Epoch, King Nohadon ruled Alethela. In one Desolation in his lifetime, nine in ten of its people died.
Nohadon wanted to abdicate, but rebuilt Alethela over decades into a bustling, colourful land, and later went to war with Makabakam over trade routes.
Around 4,500 years before Gavilar's death came the Last Desolation, only a year after the one before. Afterwards the Desolations stopped, beginning the Era of Solitude.
